rows.target:
<sp(20)>But if you mean to lead the world to ruin...
then all of us will stop you.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>What... what drove you this far!<ab(200)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Your very existence denied me.<ab(300)>
rows.notes: Speaker is Berkt, per hostility and "denied me" matching his glossary profile (deeply hostile toward Barrel).

rows.target: <sp(20)>A world like that has no meaning.<ab(300)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>That's wrong.<ab(300)>

<sp(20)>I saw a future in Barrel.
A future you could never find!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Speaker addressed as Faye in next row; feminine "I" not marked in English, no gender added beyond established glossary gender.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>So that's why you ran.<ab(300)>

<sp(20)>Then taste the price of believing in something like that.
Fear, and despair.<ab(300)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>Barrel came through it,
and grew stronger for it.<ab(300)>
<sp(20)>Not like you!<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>W-what do you mean, Faye?<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Please clear the Invaders while you can!<ab(800)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>To manage this much even in a situation like this...
Impressive.<ab(800)><ed()>

<on()><sp(20)>Damn you, Shin Dragon...
So you've evolved into a form like this!<ab(10000)><off()>
rows.notes: Portrait-dialogue scene begins here (resource shifts to on()/off() with confirmed speaker names from 9051 onward).

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>Doctor... why would you do something like this...<ab(10000)><off()>
rows.notes: Confirms prior antagonist is addressed as "Doctor" (Dr. Saotome).

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>The Invaders had to be destroyed
by my own hand.<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>So that Michiru's death would not be in vain.<ab(10000)><off()>
rows.notes: Short form "Michiru" for Michiru Saotome; see glossary proposal in this batch.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Tell me.
What did Adroc know!<ab(10000)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>He tried to halt the Invaders' emergence
by stopping the Ageha Plan.<ab(10000)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Meaning to build a new Ageha Plan
from the data gained through contact with Eureka.<ab(10000)><off()>
rows.notes: Eureka per Eureka Seven locked character name.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>A new Ageha Plan...<ab(10000)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Berkt... whatever happens,
don't let him make use of the Getter Rays.<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>That man is dangerous...<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>This is the last of the path I laid.<ab(10000)><off()>
rows.notes: Rail/track metaphor for a plan set in motion, rendered as "path."

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>The rest is yours to carve out - humanity's future!<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Farewell!<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Shin Dragon's life signs have vanished...!<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>The Invaders have ceased activity too.<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>We did it!<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Not yet... here it comes!<ab(10000)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Berkt!
What is the key to the Baldora Drive!<ab(10000)><off()>
rows.notes: No <book()> tag here in source (unlike later Baldora Drive mentions); preserved exactly as untagged.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>Berkt... you've lost.<ab(10000)><off()>

rows.notes: Berkt momentarily addresses the speaker as "Faye," mirroring Barrel's Faye; not resolved as the same person here.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>No.
You lost to everyone here.<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>It's over now.<ab(10000)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>The Baldora Drive chose me.
I'll be the one to open the last lock.<ab(10000)><off()>
rows.notes: No <book()> tag in source here either; preserved untagged.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>Wait!!<off()>
rows.notes: Source lacks <ab()> before <off()> here (unlike the surrounding rows); preserved as in source.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Barrel, that's enough.
There's no need to chase him.<ab(10000)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Dr. <color(5)>Saotome<ce()>, working from the <book(78)>Ageha Plan<endbook()>,
built <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()> as a means toward peace.
rows.notes: Narration/recap block begins here; source rows 9082 onward have no <ab()>/<off()> at all (unlike the preceding on() combat lines), preserved as such.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Fifteen years after <color(4)>Michiru Saotome<ce()>'s death,
he'd given himself to avenge her,
fighting on alone all along.
rows.notes: Compressed for the 110-character visible limit; full form "Michiru Saotome" used for this narration line per glossary proposal.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>I always thought of him as an enemy.
But to think that wasn't true...

<on()><sp(20)>The Doctor entrusted Earth's future to us.
We mustn't let that wish go to waste.

<on()><sp(20)>But the words the Doctor left behind...
<color(5)>Berkt<ce()> is still alive.

<on()><sp(20)><book(2)>Baldora Charge<endbook()> is approaching
critical levels.
rows.notes: "Baldora Charge" is a new term (book(2) link), not previously in project glossary; proposed by analogy with locked "Baldora Drive"/"Baldora particles." See glossary proposal.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>We should assume he's already secured
the power he needs.
There's no time left...

<on()><sp(20)>But we still don't know
what the key actually is.

<on()><sp(20)>We'd better ask <color(4)>Faye<ce()>
about that.

<on()><sp(20)><color(4)>Faye<ce()>... tell me.
Who are you, really?

<on()><sp(20)>Yes.
I've kept it hidden until now...
but I'll tell you everything now.

<on()><sp(20)>I'm from this world.
I used to belong to the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()>
and served under <color(5)>Berkt<ce()>.
rows.notes: New Federation per locked terms_028/glossary.json spelling.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)><color(5)>Berkt<ce()>!?
What's that supposed to mean!

<on()><sp(20)>I deserted the military to stop
<color(5)>Berkt<ce()>'s violence, and Dr. <color(6)>Bardona<ce()>
saved me.
rows.notes: Dr. Bardona = Jill Bardona (locked glossary name), short form used here.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>I was given an <color(4)>Ixbrau<ce()>
and fled to this world.

<on()><sp(20)>All I was given was one wish:
find <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>...
<on()><sp(20)>Then, from the very start...

<on()><sp(20)>That's right.
Finding you and drawing you into the military
was all something I planned.
<on()><sp(20)>So that's how it was...
<on()><sp(20)>But... why me?
<on()><sp(20)><color(6)>Jill Bardona<ce()> is your birth father.

<on()><sp(20)>He leaped into this world
in an accident when the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> ran out of control.

<on()><sp(20)>That was when he realized
he had formed a whole new world.

<on()><sp(20)>The <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> wasn't only a device for leaping -
it was a door that connects worlds.
rows.notes: Reworded to avoid the font's lowercase j ("just").

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>You're saying this world
branched off through the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>?

<on()><sp(20)>And the two worlds that branched apart
gradually came to take on different forms...
That's how it is.

<on()><sp(20)>What a ridiculous story...
but... looking at what's happening now,
I have no choice but to believe it now.

<on()><sp(20)>To return to his original world,
he continued developing the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>
in this world too.

<on()><sp(20)>Once he returned, he meant to destroy
both <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> units,
severing the worlds' connection for good.
rows.notes: Compressed to fit the 110-character visible limit.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>But... he was killed by <color(5)>Berkt<ce()>.
<on()><sp(20)>Why would... <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> do that?

uncertainties.note: Berkt says "...Faye?" immediately after losing, echoing Barrel's relationship to Faye; kept literal, not interpreted as Berkt having his own Faye counterpart, since the scene later (dialogue_09113-09114) shifts to Jill Bardona's death instead.
See batch_08955.json uncertainty on dialogue_09004 ("kudan no genkai"); relevant background for this slice's Saotome exposition (dialogue_09052-09053).

"Baldora Drive" appears without the <book(1)> tag at these two rows even though later rows (9088, 9105-9112, 9120, 9140) use the tag consistently; preserved exactly as the source has it rather than normalized.
"Baldora Charge" (book(2)) is a new locked-adjacent term; see glossary proposal in this batch.
